text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This aroma... Sirius, might that be
Ruhuna tea?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just, the president was telling me
the
other day: among Sri Lankan teas,
Ruhuna tea is
notable for its rich aroma.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And you like it with one spoonful of
milk... Isn't
that right, Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, how old do you think I am? I only
drink my
tea straight now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf, I think your brain's failed to
move on from
childhood. Your penchant
for being a control
freak hasn't changed
one bit!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Also, out of all the teas, you like
Dimbula, the
most mainstream of Sri
Lankan teas. Really, I
don't think we
could ever get along.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You say that, but I see you know her
favorite
tea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, Sirius has always had a good
memory!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What are you laughing at?! Forget
it,
everyone scram! Get your
entertainment
somewhere else!
